title: ThunderKittens: Simple, Fast, and $\textit{Adorable}$ Kernels

layout.note: At the left a four-tier colour pyramid with navy banners that name the tile type of each level, a mascot above it. At the right three aligned role columns under bold titles: load and store workers in a dashed code box, a narrow column of numbered input and output buffers, and compute workers in a dashed code box; arrows run between the boxes and the buffers.

lesson: Put a hierarchy (here memory levels) beside the roles that use it: a coloured pyramid whose tiers carry capacity numbers and a banner naming the type used at that level, then one titled column per role with a cartoon avatar and a dashed code box, joined by numbered buffer slots.
